court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge, Senior Division, Akola in H.M.P. No.247/2014
case_name: Subodh Ramesh Balsaraf vs Sau. Seema Subodh Balsaraf

parties.respondent_defendant: Sau. Seema Subosh Balsaraf, Legal Practitioner

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner is aggrieved by the order passed by the trial court adjusting the amount of interim maintenance granted earlier. The respondent moved an application for grant of interim maintenance in proceedings filed under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2006.

legal_principles.principle: The amount of interim maintenance that was granted by the Civil Court cannot be modified without a valid application and justification.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the respective Counsel, it can be seen that on 11-11-2014 the learned Magistrate directed payment of RS.5000/- per month towards the interim maintenance in proceedings under the Act of 2006.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2006

legal_principles.principle: The Civil Court cannot adjust the amount of interim maintenance without considering the previous orders and applications.
legal_principles.held: Instead, the Civil Court directed the amount to be adjusted to Rs.6,500/- by noting the fact that by order dated 19-11-2014 an interim maintenance of Rs.3000/- per month had been directed to be paid.

outcome.final_order: The Civil Court's direction to adjust the total amount to be paid was modified.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court cases
